book: Italian-Latin-German grammar (Grammatica italico-latino-germanica, Augsburg 1650), a single grammar by Scipione Lentulo, rendered into German, with a dedication and front matter, then grammar chapters in Latin headings with German subheadings, including conjugation and declension paradigms.
